info.name: POS & QR Ordering System API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for testing all REST API endpoints of the POS & QR Ordering System Backend.

### Authentication
- **Admin**: `admin` / `password`
- **Cashier**: `cashier` / `password`
- **Kitchen**: `kitchen` / `password`

*Running any of the login requests will automatically set the corresponding bearer token in collection/environment variables.*
